Feeling nervous? You're in good hands.

It's completely normal to feel anxious about implant treatment — most of our patients did too. From your first visit, we take the time to explain everything clearly, answer every question, and never rush you. Our calm, family-run approach and gentle techniques are designed to make the whole experience as comfortable and reassuring as possible.

Meet the team

Implants here are placed and restored by a husband-and-wife dentist team — more than 50 placed together — backed by a team that's looked after this community for decades. Select anyone to read their story.

Dr Dimitrios Sourtzis

Implant treatment provider · Dentist · GDC No. 287145

I graduated from the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki and moved to the UK in 2020, building my dental career in Louth. My postgraduate training runs deep: a Master’s in Endodontics at King’s College London, a Diploma in Implant Dentistry, Minor Oral Surgery training at King’s — and I’m now completing a further surgical diploma to deepen that expertise.

Implants at Cygnet House are a two-dentist partnership. I place them; my wife, Dr Rose — completing a double Master’s in Prosthodontics — plans and restores them with me. Together we have placed more than 50 implants, and every case is planned restoratively: we design your final teeth first, then place the implants to support them.

I’m meticulous about diagnosis. I use a dental microscope for every root canal and every complex diagnostic case — the same precision-first mindset I bring to implant surgery.
